name: Example: a paid clipping campaign with a sponsor
audience_rule: At least 50% of viewers from the US, Canada, UK, Australia or New Zealand (check your campaign's own rule).
brief:
Campaign: a streamer's sponsored event (paste the campaign's brief here, in full).

Clip rules:
- Only footage from the event the campaign links to.
- The sponsor must be visible or mentioned in every clip.
- One clear moment per clip: hook in the first 2 seconds, clear payoff.
- No misleading titles, fake context or clickbait.

Caption rules:
- Mention the sponsor and the streamer; include the required hashtags.
posting_checklist: Sponsor logo on screen (watermark) and in the caption
Submit the post link on the campaign page within its time limit
Check the audience rule before submitting
